metadata.technology_specification: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) for electric vehicles
metadata.technology_reasoning: Permanent magnet synchronous motors are the predominant motor type used in electric vehicles (over 70% of BEVs as of 2024) due to their high efficiency, power density, and favorable torque characteristics, making them the industry-standard traction motor for passenger EVs.

components.reasoning: The stator is the stationary part of the motor with windings that create the magnetic field; it is a fundamental, separate manufactured assembly essential to motor operation.
The rotor includes a core embedded with permanent magnets, providing the rotating magnetic field; procured or manufactured as a distinct assembly and central to motor function.
The rotor shaft transmits mechanical torque from the rotor to the drivetrain; it is a critical structural component typically manufactured separately.
Encloses and protects internal motor components, provides mounting points; usually a separately manufactured structural assembly.
Support the rotor shaft reducing friction and enabling smooth rotation; these are discrete components procured from bearing suppliers.
Provides electrical connections for power and sensors, typically a separate module attached to the motor housing.

components.component: Cooling System (Water Jacket or Air Cooling System)
components.reasoning: Maintains optimal motor operating temperature, often integrated but also can be a separately manufactured subsystem, especially in high-performance EV motors.

Stator Assembly.name: Copper
Stator Assembly.reasoning: Copper is essential for the stator windings due to its excellent electrical conductivity, universally used in electric motors.

Stator Assembly.name: Epoxy resins
Stator Assembly.reasoning: Used for insulation and mechanical stability of windings; there are alternatives but epoxy resin is typical.

Stator Assembly.name: Aluminum
Stator Assembly.reasoning: Sometimes used instead of copper for windings in cost-sensitive designs, but less common in EV motors.

Rotor Assembly with Permanent Magnets.name: Neodymium
Rotor Assembly with Permanent Magnets.reasoning: Neodymium is critical for high-strength permanent magnets used in EV motor rotors; no commercially viable alternatives match performance.

Rotor Assembly with Permanent Magnets.name: Iron
Rotor Assembly with Permanent Magnets.reasoning: Forms the base of the rotor core and magnet structure, universally essential in electric motors.

Rotor Assembly with Permanent Magnets.name: Copper
Rotor Assembly with Permanent Magnets.reasoning: Used in rotor windings or bars (in case of wound rotor or squirrel cage), common in rotors but occasionally substituted by aluminum.

Rotor Assembly with Permanent Magnets.name: Aluminum
Rotor Assembly with Permanent Magnets.reasoning: Widely used in squirrel cage rotor bars, a cost-effective substitute for copper.

Rotor Shaft.name: Steel Ingots
Rotor Shaft.reasoning: The shaft requires very high strength and toughness, steel ingots represent the base steel material for shafts in EV motors, universally essential.

Rotor Shaft.name: Chromium
Rotor Shaft.reasoning: Often used in alloy form to improve hardness and corrosion resistance; common but not absolutely mandatory.

Housing (Motor Frame).name: Aluminum
Housing (Motor Frame).reasoning: Aluminum is widely used for motor housings due to its light weight and good thermal conductivity.

Housing (Motor Frame).name: Steel Ingots
Housing (Motor Frame).reasoning: Alternative material for motor housing offering higher strength but heavier.

Bearings.name: Steel Ingots
Bearings.reasoning: High-grade steel ingots form the basis of bearing races and balls due to their hardness and wear resistance.

Bearings.name: Chromium
Bearings.reasoning: Chromium is typically alloyed with steel in bearing components for hardness and corrosion resistance.

Electrical Connectors and Terminal Box.name: Copper
Electrical Connectors and Terminal Box.reasoning: Copper is essential for electrical connectors due to excellent electrical conductivity.

Electrical Connectors and Terminal Box.name: Aluminum
Electrical Connectors and Terminal Box.reasoning: Sometimes used in connectors or housings but less common than copper and plastics.

Cooling System (Water Jacket or Air Cool.name: Aluminum
Cooling System (Water Jacket or Air Cool.reasoning: Aluminum is widely used for cooling jackets and fins due to its thermal conductivity and light weight.

Cooling System (Water Jacket or Air Cool.name: Steel Ingots
Cooling System (Water Jacket or Air Cool.reasoning: Steel may be used for structural elements or fasteners; less common than aluminum but possible.
